# proxmox_qemu_agent_fsfreeze (Resource)

Freezes guest filesystems on create and thaws them on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_qemu_agent_fsfreeze" "f" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
